name: Mengjing Guanli Ju - Emeng Ruqin Pian
original_name: 梦境管理局 噩梦入侵篇
source:
This is a visual novel that tells the story of the protagonist being engulfed by a nightmare and engaging in special interactions with two other characters within an illusion.

[From [url=https://skybruise.itch.io/dream-agency-rex]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
這部視覺小說講述主角被惡夢吞噬，在幻境中與另外兩名角色展開特殊互動的故事。

［摘自[url=https://skybruise.itch.io/dream-agency-rex]itch.io[/url]］
